name: openbb_equity_discovery_active
description:
Most actively traded US stocks today through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.discovery.active).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 25; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, yfinance; default yfinance).
Custom filters: openbb_equity_screener; Yahoo screens: yf_screener; other source: fmp_most_active. Keys: yfinance needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"limit": 10}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
